messages:
leo: Starting routing-v2 staged rollout (canary 15%) to EU. Kicking off smoke probes for prefill and fanout.

deploy-bot: [deploy] routing-v2 canary=15% eu-west1 at 2026-03-25T07:12Z. Metrics -> /deploys/3032104321.

maya: Synth alert: p95 in eu-west1 jumped to 340ms after ~2m. kv_prefill_miss ~0.13. No increase in 5xx. Trace shows extra fanout.

leo: Quick health check on canary host: `latency_ms=340, kv_miss=0.13, prefill_queue=250`

opsbot: Suggested action: queue dry-pin eu-west1 -> routing-v1. Promote with `/ops pin promote 3032104321 eu-west1`.

maya: Agree to pin EU and pause the rest of the rollout. We should also add a canary gate to assert kv_miss <0.05 for 2 minutes before any ramp.

leo: Promoting pin now. Pausing remaining regions.

deploy-bot: Pin applied at 3032104352: eu-west1 -> routing-v1 (100%). Canary halted.

leo: Post-pin check: p95 back to ~90ms within 60s, kv_miss down to 0.02. Opening INF-601 to debug prefill key format drift. Adding prefill check to canary checklist. Closing thread.
